messages:
Sam: Quick sprint  need a bite-sized SDR cheat + 3 battlecard zingers and strict inbound routing for benchmark/latency leads. Timebox 60m.

Lou: I'll do the zingers. Lead with predictable unit economics, deployment parity, and graceful fallbacks. Each <= 16 words.

Lou: Draft zingers:
- CloudX: "Huge model catalog; pricing and tail latency can be unpredictable at scale." -> Rebut: "Unified runtime with batching + caching to stabilize unit economics and meet latency SLOs."
- LLMAPI: "Easy to call, no deployment parity or deep observability." -> Rebut: "Same API across hosted/dedicated/private + token-level cost and latency breakdowns."
- InfraCo: "You run infra; you carry ops burden." -> Rebut: "Managed runtime + migration playbook; optional private control plane for regulated customers."

Sam: Routing rules (strict):
```
- id: sdr_bench
  pattern: ".*(benchmark|latency|p95|p50|throughput|cost per token).*"
  queue: sdr-bench
  priority: 100
- id: ae_enterprise
  pattern: ".*(SLA|enterprise|private deployment|VPC|dedicated|reserved).*"
  queue: ae-enterprise
  priority: 80
- id: solutions
  pattern: ".*(on-prem|air-gapped|HSM|HIPAA|SOC 2).*"
  queue: solutions
  priority: 90
```

Ops: Can stage those patterns. We'll run a 24h replay and require false-positive rate <3% before promoting. Logs will include match confidence and original message.

Bench-bot: new benchmark (2026-09-10) upload: "~19% lower p50 vs CloudX on dedicated pools (quant Q3); throughput ~1.3x at 4k seq with continuous batching." Methodology link: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-sept.

LegalBot: All external soundbites must include exact caveat: "Measured on dedicated pools; config: quant Q3; see methodology: https://drive.redwood/benchmarks/2026-sept". Use verbatim.

Sam: SDR cheat (v0):
Opener: "Redwood Inference: predictable inference economics and one API across hosted, dedicated, private."
Top pains + rebut (snackable):
- "Latency spikes" -> "We stabilize tail with batching, cache, and fallback policies."
- "Token cost surprises" -> "Unit-econ controls and per-route cost visibility to reduce variance."
- "No dev-prod parity" -> "Same API surface and rollout tools across environments."
Qualifiers: "Are you on reserved/dedicated capacity? Any p95 targets?"
Routing hint: "Tag lead 'bench' if they mention latency/cost/throughput."
Caveat: append LegalBot's exact string at bottom.

Sam: Action items: @Lou finalize battlecard lines by 10:30, @Ops stage routing and run replay, @Sam finalize SDR cheat and attach caveat by 11:00. Quick review at 11:15. Thanks :rocket:
